This is an admirable quality in Islamic society, as peace and tranquility are highly valued. The name Saim could also be seen as a reminder of Allah's power and control over the sea and people's lives.

It is a call to remember Allah's power and seek His tranquility and peace in our lives. Furthermore, the name Saim may be seen as a reminder of the importance of inner peace and calmness, and to strive towards achieving a peaceful and tranquil heart and soul.
